name: Collapsible
description: One disclosure: a trigger, and the content it reveals.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The control that opens it, handed the props that wire it to the panel. It has to be a button.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out and the widget owns it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires with the new state and why it changed.

a11y: The trigger carries `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the content has no role of its own, because a region wants a name and a trigger is not a heading. Use an `Accordion` where the sections are document structure.
